core_thesis.market_pain: 重度 AI 用户同时用 ChatGPT、Claude、Gemini、Grok 四家，对话散落在四个侧边栏里没法统一搜索、分组和复用提示词；各家官方界面只管自家历史，跨平台找一段旧对话只能逐个翻。
core_thesis.opportunity_arbitrage: 官方永远不会索引竞品的对话，跨平台全文搜索和统一文件夹是插件独有的位置。数据只存浏览器本地、零服务器成本，敢卖终身制；单平台 9.99 美元/月或 99 美元终身、四平台捆绑 200 美元。与库内通用插件案例的差异：只做 AI 对话整理这一件事、跨四平台，不做泛效率工具。

deep_dive.opportunity: Heavy AI users spread chats across four platforms with no unified search, folders or prompt reuse, and no vendor will index a rival's history. A local-only extension owns that cross-platform layer at near-zero running cost, so lifetime pricing works. Unlike generic extension plays, this does one job across four platforms.
deep_dive.risk_and_pitfalls: Any platform can break the extension with a DOM change or ship native folders and search. Keep selectors isolated per platform, ship fixes within 48 hours, and never upload chat content to a server.
workflow: Phase 01: Mine 1-3 star reviews of rival organizers to lock the three recurring pains worth charging for.
Phase 02: Ship one platform first: folders, full-text search and export with a local index and minimal permissions.
Phase 03: Sell per-platform monthly and lifetime plans plus an all-access bundle through a merchant of record.
Phase 04: Grow through store search terms, comparison pages and a free tier capped at 2 folders.

en.verdict: Best evidence quality in this batch (TrustMRR verified), but revenue is lifetime-heavy and platform changes can break it; a solid C-tier niche play.
